One of the standout features of Angry Birds Casual is its variety of birds. From the classic Red Bird to the more exotic Blue Bird, each bird has its unique abilities and strengths, which players can use to overcome obstacles and defeat enemies. But that's not all – the game also introduces new birds and abilities as you progress, keeping the gameplay fresh and exciting.

But Angry Birds Casual is more than just a puzzle game – it's also a game of strategy.
